_help: Colour-blind palettes (settings: palette). hp: the HP bar's three colours (healthy, below half, below a quarter); elements: the colour of each element's bolts and glows. Colour names come from the game's 32-colour palette (engine/render.py), so nothing ever clashes. Chosen so that the three HP states and Fire/Nature/Tide/Storm differ in brightness, not only in hue.
